stops.title: Dinner at Roman Camp Restaurant
stops.highlightNote: 2 AA Rosette dining in a beautiful candlelit dining room. Scottish seasonal menu.
stops.expandedNote: In-house restaurant. Reservation essential — only 16 covers. Tasting menu available Friday-Saturday but à la carte Mon-Thurs. October means grouse, partridge, and venison. Excellent Scottish cheese selection. Very peaceful end to a busy day.

stops.title: Drive Callander to Glasgow
stops.highlightNote: 1-hour easy drive south to Glasgow. Drop the car at the hotel — you won't need it in the city.
stops.expandedNote: Route: Callander → A84 → M80 → M8 into Glasgow city centre. Hotel has valet parking — ask about overnight rate. No need for the car in Glasgow for the rest of the trip. Return the rental tomorrow morning.

stops.title: Kelvingrove Art Gallery
stops.highlightNote: One of the UK's best free museums — Salvador Dali's Christ of St John of the Cross lives here.
stops.expandedNote: Free entry. The Dali painting is extraordinary. Also: Dutch Masters, Charles Rennie Mackintosh room, Spitfire hanging from the ceiling. Allow 2 hours minimum. Café on the ground floor for a break. The building itself (1901) is spectacular — look at the rear entrance.

stops.title: Lunch at The Ubiquitous Chip
stops.highlightNote: Glasgow's most famous restaurant — 50 years in a cobbled lane. Scottish produce at its finest.
stops.expandedNote: Reservation under Malda. The brasserie upstairs is more casual and affordable than the main restaurant downstairs. Known for haggis bons bons, venison, and outstanding Scottish cheeses. In the lovely West End's Ashton Lane — explore the lane before and after lunch.

stops.title: Check in — Kimpton Blythswood Square
stops.highlightNote: Glasgow's finest hotel — in a restored Georgian townhouse around an elegant city square.
stops.expandedNote: Confirmation: KB-2026-MALDA. Elegant city hotel in a beautiful Georgian square. Spa downstairs — book a treatment (champagne afternoon tea in the spa is a treat). Cocktail bar is one of Glasgow's best. Central location — everything walkable.

stops.title: Merchant City & Glasgow Cathedral
stops.highlightNote: The medieval heart of Glasgow. The Cathedral is stunning and largely intact.
stops.expandedNote: Glasgow Cathedral is free and one of the most complete medieval churches in Scotland. Adjacent Necropolis is Glasgow's Victorian garden cemetery on a hill — extraordinary. Merchant City nearby has great independent shops and galleries.

stops.title: Dinner at Ox and Finch
stops.highlightNote: Glasgow's best sharing plates restaurant — modern, lively, and superb quality.
stops.expandedNote: Reservation under Malda. Small plates to share — order 4-5 per person. Known for the cured meats, langoustines, and beef tartare. Wine list is thoughtfully sourced. Very lively atmosphere — Glasgow at its best. ~£60pp with wine.

stops.title: Return rental car
stops.address: Arnold Clark, 84 Lancefield St, Glasgow G3 8JE
stops.highlightNote: Return the rental before 10am to avoid extra day charge.
stops.expandedNote: Arnold Clark Glasgow Lancefield Street branch. Reference: AC-SCOT-2026. Full tank on return. Note any scratches on the return form. Take photos of the car before handover. Uber or taxi back to hotel: ~10 minutes.

stops.title: Breakfast & final Glasgow wander
stops.highlightNote: Last morning — walk Buchanan Street and grab breakfast at Paesano for a Scottish farewell.
stops.expandedNote: Paesano Pizza on Great Western Road does an excellent morning roll and coffee. Buchanan Street is Glasgow's main shopping street — good for last minute gifts. The Lighthouse (Charles Rennie Mackintosh's building) is a free visit and has a rooftop view of Glasgow.

stops.title: Check out & transfer to Glasgow Airport
stops.highlightNote: About 20 minutes from city centre by taxi or Paisley Canal train.
stops.expandedNote: Check out by 12:00 — ask hotel to hold luggage if needed. Taxi from Blythswood Square to airport: ~£25 and 20-25 mins. Train: Glasgow Central → Paisley Canal is 20 mins, then short walk. Allow 2.5 hours for international departure.

stops.title: Depart Glasgow Airport
stops.highlightNote: Scotland done. 14 incredible days in the bag.
stops.expandedNote: Flight departure: check airline confirmation for gate. Glasgow Airport is compact — 45 minutes from arrival to gate is comfortable. Final duty-free whisky purchase opportunity! The trip ends here but the memories last forever.
